relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: we found a temporal sharpening of response durations and generalized increases in pairwise neural correlations in the presence of the mechanistically distinct analgesics gabapentin or ibuprofen after (but not before) CFA-induced inflammatory pain

relationships.subject: ibuprofen
relationships.evidence_quote: we found a temporal sharpening of response durations and generalized increases in pairwise neural correlations in the presence of the mechanistically distinct analgesics gabapentin or ibuprofen after (but not before) CFA-induced inflammatory pain

key_findings: ACC single-cell representations of pain stimuli were flexible with no robust nociceptive ensemble; analgesics after CFA increased pairwise correlations and sharpened response durations.
